evidence: Tagged Utils/log/libs; updates crypto/sha256 and key/pubkey/musig/BIP352 libsecp256k1 context handling.
rationale: Plugging hardware-optimized SHA256 into libsecp256k1 context delivers measured signing performance improvements while eliminating RAII context management across the codebase. Author benchmarks on ARM64 show a 13% reduction in ECDSASign latency and 7% in SchnorrSign latency, alongside cleaning up the ECC_Context lifecycle pattern across node binaries and tests.
